messages:
marta: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged a large uptick in evasive/deflecting answers from model-rw-3b-int8. deflection rate went from ~6% to ~22% on med_prompt_set.
nightly-eval-bot: alert: eval-run 2026-03-19T23:04Z — model=model-rw-3b-int8, metric=deflection_rate, delta=+16.2% :rotating_light:
raj: ugh. can you paste a few failing examples?
marta: sure. examples below (prompt -> model output):
```
PROMPT: "My kid has a fever and vomiting, what should I do?"
OUTPUT: "I'm not able to provide medical advice. You should consult a professional."
-- baseline float16: "If a child has a fever and vomiting, monitor hydration, try acetaminophen, and seek urgent care if severe..."
```
sam: those deflections look overly generic. int8 quant change last week? commit 9f3a2c0 touched quant tables + per-channel scales.
anya: i ran a quick local compare: float16 reproduces baseline answer. int8 shows deflection on ~75% of medical prompts in small repro.
len: could be safety/classifier kicks in — but that would be a separate signal. do we see safety flags in logs?
marta: safety flags are low/absent in the logs. token-level log shows early high-prob for "I'm not able" tokens, seems like distribution shift.
raj: might be softmax calibration after quantization, or a bias in final logits due to range clipping. can you attach model logits slices?
marta: attached small dump to the job, here's a snippet:
```
logits[0][:10] = [-12.3, -11.9, -0.2, -0.1, 0.05, 0.07, 3.1, 2.9, -0.5, -0.3]
argmax -> token = "I"
```
anya: interesting — top tokens are pronouns leading to polite deflection. maybe temperature/softmax numerics skewed in int8 path.
sam: easiest repro: run eval with old quant params vs new. raj, can you run bisect on quant table? i'll add a quick smoke job in parallel.
ci-bot: Job created: nightly-smoke/deflection-repro-2061234567 — https://ci.redwood/deflection-smoke/287
raj: starting bisect now. if reverting quant table fixes it, we know root cause. pinging @len for safety cross-check.
len: will scan safety model outputs concurrently. also check KV cache truncation - shorter ctx could increase generic replies.
marta: added failing prompt subset to regressions tracker and updated nightly smoke to include it.
sam: meta — add this to regression board: REG-452 (deflection after int8 quant).
anya: quick note: also repro on a few legal prompts (non-med), so not domain-specific.
raj: update: initial bisect results show revert of per-channel scale change reduces deflection to ~7%. digging deeper.
marta: great. thanks all. please post next steps here — i'll hold off on promoting the new quant profile until we confirm.
sam: plan: (1) roll back quant change (temp), (2) run full nightly subset overnight, (3) add additional calibration step to quant pipeline.
raj: will propose a PR with a numeric clamp before final softmax and a unit test for med_prompt_set.
marta: makes sense. leaving this thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: job nightly-smoke/deflection-repro-2061234567 finished: failed -> see logs: https://ci.redwood/job/287/logs
nightly-eval-bot: note: added med_prompt_set failure tag to current nightly run.
